title: Pulse Bot — Market Scanner & Discord Alerts
description: An automated daily scanner built in pure Python that tracks market trends, checks news headlines with Gemini to spot sudden company risks, and sends clean summary cards to Discord via webhooks before the market opens.
highlights: Built with pure Python standard library — zero third-party package dependencies
Uses Gemini to scan recent news headlines and flag sudden events (profit warnings, unexpected news)
Formats and sends clean, color-coded daily summary cards to Discord via webhooks
Runs automatically every weekday morning on GitHub Actions with automated state tracking

title: TDD & Prompt Engineering Research
description: Degree research exploring how AI prompt engineering can assist developers in writing unit tests, structuring test cases, and adopting Test-Driven Development (TDD).
highlights: Empirical study on prompt design patterns for automated unit test generation
Co-authored thesis at Blekinge Institute of Technology (BTH)
Published and archived in the Swedish academic DiVA portal

title: CloudVault - Secure File Storage & Sharing
description: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage platform with instant shareable links, version history, and role-based workspace permissions.
highlights: Client-side encryption using AES-GCM and Web Crypto API
Chunked multi-part upload engine handling large files
Granular file permission management and expiring share links

title: DevFlow - CLI Task & Workflow Automator
description: A developer-first command-line tool to automate project scaffolding, git hooks, environment configurations, and continuous delivery.
highlights: Automates repetitive development setup and environment initialization
Cross-platform support and minimal dependency footprint

title: ZenNote - Offline-First Markdown Studio
description: Distraction-free markdown editor with live split-screen preview, LaTeX math typesetting, and local synchronization.
highlights: 100% offline functionality as an installable Progressive Web App
Instant export to PDF, HTML, and presentation formats
Built with vanilla web standards and local IndexedDB caching
